description:
Verifies the measured pilot of the exploratory batch-size sweep family and records its outcome.

## Background

The pilot addendum, ledger and queue line of the exploratory batch-size sweep family are committed under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/` and `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/`; the benchmark window runs the queued pilot. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The pilot campaign is verified from its own append-only execution log with the shared campaign-log verifier: cell starts and completions equal the addendum's cell count, each cell is measured at its declared pairs, and a terminal complete record closes the log.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt is committed with its input snapshots, the receipt-input snapshot check passes, and the `benchmark-acceptance` verdict recomputed from the committed receipt reproduces the committed acceptance summary byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: The family stays exploratory: its outcome is recorded as a pilot, it queues no confirmation, and the reason is stated.
- [hard] REQ-04: The report states whether the campaign is measured or waits for a window.
title: Collect the batch-size sweep pilot
